title: Wires Over a Sunset Cloud
description: Based on a photograph, this painting elevates a commonplace urban view into a moment of quiet beauty. A soft cloud, illuminated by the warm light of sunset, provides a natural counterpoint to the man-made structures.

title: Winter Bear Statue
description: I discovered the subject for this painting during a winter walk in my neighborhood. I saw this charming bear statue, about 80cm tall, holding a small lantern. I found it so endearing and whimsical. This piece is my effort to capture that simple, unexpected moment of delight on a cold day.

title: Where Sight Takes Flight
description: Here, physical sight takes flight on delicate wings, trading the world seen for the world felt. Her eyes are veiled, not in darkness, but in a fragile, living curtain.

title: Where Light Lingers
description: Based on a photograph, this painting depicts a girl in a school uniform during the golden hour. Viewed from behind, her figure is set against a vast sky, capturing a quiet and nostalgic mood.

title: Yellow Fruit Study
description: A watercolor still life fruit study on 9x12 inch cotton paper, created as a practice piece through reference painting.

title: Yellow Fruit Study
description: A watercolor still life fruit study on 9x12 inch cotton paper, created as a practice piece through reference painting.

title: Vietnamese Girl in Field
description: An oil painting of a Vietnamese girl in a blue coat and traditional hat, inspired by a photograph, standing in a lush field of wildflowers.

title: The Fish Thief
description: In this piece, I wanted to translate a fleeting, amusing scene into a lasting narrative on canvas. The cool, atmospheric tones of the fishing port serve as a backdrop to the sharp contrast and determination of the 'fish thief,' highlighting my interest in blending realistic animal portraiture with dynamic storytelling.

title: Trees by Sunset
description: Glowing marsh sunset sets silhouetted trees against a sky of tangerine and rose, with the sinking sun mirrored in calm water for a quiet, reflective mood.

title: Tiger Portrait I
description: A practice study portraying a tiger in rich, warm tones. Fine brushwork captures the texture of its fur and the intensity of its gaze, while the dark, blurred background draws focus to the animal's expressive face.

title: Crowned Bunny Girl
description: An oil painting topped with a crowned lop-ear bunny I once raised, created in 2017 when I began exploring oil painting. Before this, my color work primarily focused on watercolor, adding a unique blend of techniques to this whimsical piece.

title: The Traveler and the Finch
description: This portrait, based on a photograph, is a study of skin tones in cool shadow.

title: Furry Force- Fighter Pilot
description: A painting combining the imagery of a rabbit with the attire of a fighter pilot. The softness of the animal contrasts sharply with the disciplined, almost mechanical nature of military aviation.

title: Furry Force- Lethal Fluff
description: Part of the Furry Forces series, this work pairs soft, endearing rabbits with regimented military gear to reframe conflict through cuteness

title: Furry Force - Night Out SWAT
description: A rabbit portrayed as a SWAT operative, seen off duty at night after a mission. The neon city lights and playful attire contrast with the figure's military role.

title: A Pool Day I
description: As someone who has always loved water and swimming, I feel a deep sense of tranquility near pools. This painting, and the series it's part of, was inspired by a photograph that perfectly captured that feeling of quiet and leisure. I felt an immediate desire to translate that lazy, peaceful atmosphere onto the canvas, using cool tones and fluid brushwork to express the calm escape that water represents to me.

title: Sun-Kissed Peaches
description: I used a bold, impressionistic color palette to translate the feeling of natural vitality onto the canvas. By layering warm reds and oranges against the cool turquoise, I sought to express the intense energy and vibrant glow of life in the natural world.

title: Penguin Haven
description: This piece is an observation of life in one of the earth's most remote environments. I was drawn to the contrast between the penguins' playful presence and the immense, open horizon. Through layered oil techniques, I sought to convey a sense of freedom and the breathtaking scale of the wilderness that resonates with my own feelings of peace.

title: Green Hills
description: The composition features a field of yellow wildflowers in the foreground, rolling green hills, and a small alpine lake in the distance.

title: Open to the new day
description: This painting was my first venture into large-scale oil painting, and it marked a turning point in my practice. While working on this canvas, I discovered the profound sense of immersion that comes with creating on a larger scale.

title: Lop-Eared Rabbit I
description: Based on a photograph, this portrait captures the rabbit's whimsical and studious nature.

title: Bathed in Afternoon Light by the Window
description: Based on a photograph, this painting captures the dramatic effect of a sunset window casting long shadows across a studio.

title: Rainy Street Scene
description: A study piece capturing the glow of city lights against a rainy, misty day. The reflections on the wet pavement and tram rails create depth and atmosphere.

title: Furry Assembly
description: This painting features 91 pets, all based on photos sent to me by friends and colleagues. At the very center is my own cat, Chopper, a Siamese wearing a yellow cone of shame. It's the piece I've spent the longest time on??around 180 hours in total, averaging about two hours per pet.There were moments when I felt like giving up, but this focused practice truly helped me grow more fluid and confident with each brushstroke. I painted them row by row, starting from the bottom right corner and working upward across the canvas.

title: Paris Street Study
description: A study focusing on natural lighting and spatial composition, part of an ongoing practice in representational still life.

title: Frostpaw Lynx
description: A young lynx with big, fluffy paws resting in the snow. Its bright golden eyes and soft fur bring out a playful, gentle charm.

title: Still Life Study – Green Tone Ground
description: Painted as part of a still life study series, this piece explores shape, shadow, and color harmony on a green-toned ground.

title: Skylight Plants Practice
description: See green plants hanging from a pink-painted roof, a practice from a photo.

title: Yellow Train
description: Painted from photo reference as part of a practice series exploring vintage trains and the quiet atmosphere of historic railway stations.

title: Blossoming Serenity
description: A simple watercolor practice of plant flowers, showcasing soft hues and natural forms with a touch of traditional charm.

title: Still Life Practice – No.1
description: A study focusing on natural lighting and spatial composition, part of an ongoing practice in representational still life.

title: Shadowed Threshold
description: This painting was my first venture into large-scale oil painting, and it marked a turning point in my practice. While working on this canvas, I discovered the profound sense of immersion that comes with creating on a larger scale.

title: Cosmic Duo
description: An acrylic painting from 2016, this artwork features two vibrant planets set in the vastness of space. I painted it because of my love for galaxies, and I especially enjoy the brushstrokes of the blue planet.

title: Short Hair-Daylight
description: Working from a photo, I started this piece with a vibrant pink ground for the canvas, and I especially love how that pink tone subtly peeks through the layers of white paint on the shirt.

title: Dream - Calm Encounter
description: The painting reflects a vivid dream I had in which a tiger appeared at my door, calm and watchful. Its presence was powerful yet strangely comforting, free of fear—blurring the line between dream and reality.

title: Plein Air - Cancun Shoreline Reflections
description: Painted from the resort lobby overlooking the shoreline, capturing the rhythmic movement of waves under a shifting sky. Weathered wooden posts stand quietly in the surf, their reflections shimmering on the wet sand.

title: Drifting From Within
description: I painted this to explore a deeply personal feeling—a sudden, unprovoked sense of emptiness, as if my inner self has been hollowed out. By showing soft clouds drifting from within the figure, I wanted to turn that void into a moment of quiet, ethereal beauty, finding a sense of peace within the stillness of the unknown

title: Peach Study No.1
description: A study piece from a reference, focusing on the soft textures and warm blush tones of a ripe peach. Gentle shading and subtle color transitions capture its round form and delicate skin.

title: Plein Air – Lobby View Cancun Resort
